findings.detail: The non-accrual total of 6,050 ties to the VG Target SOFR row only, but the flag counted five footnote-sourced positions.
VG Target PRIME carries similar footnotes but its 251 amortized cost is not included in the 6,050 non-accrual bucket.

rationale: The filing reports Non-Accrual amortized cost of 6,050. That amount matches the VG Target Holdings SOFR term loan row's amortized cost of 6,050, while the reviewed flag reports five non-accrual positions from footnotes. A second VG Target row with the same broad footnote pattern has amortized cost 251 and is not included in the 6,050 non-accrual bucket, showing the footnote extraction is overinclusive.
